hiroko_lv3_another_hospital_lights.title: Lights of Another Hospital
hiroko_lv3_another_hospital_lights.teaser: Walking past the corridor after an on-time shift, you run into Hiroko carrying a light-green paper bag with a thermos and a gardening picture book.

choices.choice_hlv3_048_1: "Waiting until we walked all the way here to tell me—does that mean I passed Nurse Sugimura's inspection?"
choices.choice_hlv3_048_2: "Balancing both sides on your own for this long really hasn't been easy."
choices.finish_hiroko_lv3: Watch Hiroko walk up the stairs to the station platform

nodes.hlv3_001: At ten to five in the afternoon, the surgical department corridor is quiet and orderly.
nodes.hlv3_002: Hiroko Sugimura stands beside the counter in the instrument prep room, neatly arranging sterile suture boxes by size for tomorrow's first operation. Hearing footsteps at the door, she turns and deftly hands the annotated handover board to Ryuji Sakaguchi as he walks in.
nodes.hlv3_003: "Dr. Sakaguchi, the recovery room handover records for both of this afternoon's post-op patients have been double-checked. Also, the patient for tomorrow morning's first surgery has fairly sensitive skin, so I put an extra roll of hypoallergenic non-woven tape in the supply basket—we can switch to that directly when securing the post-op dressing tomorrow."
nodes.hlv3_004: Ryuji Sakaguchi glances over the handover board and nods:
nodes.hlv3_005: "Thinking ahead even to the tape for the post-op dressing—thorough as always."
nodes.hlv3_006: Hiroko Sugimura gives a faint smile:
nodes.hlv3_007: "During rounds last time, I noticed the skin around her wrist IV site was slightly red. Preparing it in advance is much less trouble than looking for it on the spot."
nodes.hlv3_008: Ryuji Sakaguchi signs his name and sets the clipboard back in place:
nodes.hlv3_009: "There are no add-on cases today either, so we finally get to wrap up on time again."
nodes.hlv3_010: "Yes. I'll head to the locker room to change, then. Thank you for your hard work today, Doctor."
nodes.hlv3_011: Ten minutes later, Ryuji Sakaguchi walks out of the staff corridor in his street clothes and runs into Hiroko Sugimura again near the side of the main lobby.
nodes.hlv3_012: Hiroko has changed into a gentle light-beige knit top and a long deep-blue skirt. Besides her usual commuter bag, she is carrying a light-green paper bag, with a thermos and a neatly bound gardening picture book peeking out from the top.
nodes.hlv3_013: She glances down at her wristwatch, walking slightly faster than usual as if timing a train or bus.
nodes.hlv3_014: Ryuji Sakaguchi steps up and greets her casually:
nodes.hlv3_015: "Hiroko, meeting up with a friend tonight?"
nodes.hlv3_016: Hiroko Sugimura pauses and turns toward him:
nodes.hlv3_018: Her fingers tighten slightly around the handles of the light-green paper bag, her gaze resting on Ryuji's face for two seconds as if hesitating over how to answer.
nodes.hlv3_019: Noticing her subtle expression, Ryuji Sakaguchi adds gently:
nodes.hlv3_020: "If you're in a hurry, don't mind me—go right ahead."
nodes.hlv3_021: Hiroko Sugimura shakes her head, that brief hesitation quickly giving way to a warm, earnest look. She raises her eyes to Ryuji and speaks up on her own:
nodes.hlv3_022: "I'm not in that much of a rush. It's just... Dr. Sakaguchi, if you're heading straight to the station right now, would you mind walking part of the way with me?"
nodes.hlv3_023: Slightly surprised, Ryuji Sakaguchi smiles and nods:
nodes.hlv3_024: "Sure. I don't have anything urgent on my end anyway."
nodes.hlv3_025: Hiroko Sugimura lets out a soft breath, the corners of her lips curving into a faint smile:
nodes.hlv3_026: "Thank you, Doctor. Shall we go, then?"
nodes.hlv3_027: The evening sun stretches the shadows of the roadside trees long across the pavement as the after-work crowd slowly disperses along the sidewalk.
nodes.hlv3_028: Walking side by side past the fork in the shopping district, the two of them do not turn toward their usual train station, instead taking a quiet walkway leading toward the neighboring ward.
nodes.hlv3_029: Ryuji Sakaguchi glances at the paper bag in her hand:
nodes.hlv3_030: "Is that a gardening book in the bag? Sounds like the friend you're visiting today is pretty fond of flowers."
nodes.hlv3_031: Hiroko Sugimura looks down at the book in her hand, her fingers lightly brushing the edge of the paper bag, her voice natural yet tinged with a shy softness:
nodes.hlv3_032: "I'm not going to see a friend... I'm going to visit my mother. She's staying at a hospital over this way."
nodes.hlv3_033: Ryuji Sakaguchi blinks slightly, slowing his pace by half a beat:
nodes.hlv3_035: Hiroko Sugimura nods, her tone calm and candid:
nodes.hlv3_036: "Yes. She's been staying at the municipal general hospital two bus stops ahead for quite a while now."
nodes.hlv3_037: Stopping before a red pedestrian light at the crosswalk, the evening breeze lifts the stray locks by Hiroko's ear. Watching the signal blinking across the street, she continues in a peaceful, conversational voice:
nodes.hlv3_038: "When I was very young, my father passed away from an illness. For as long as I can remember, it was just my mother at home—going out to work while looking after my schoolwork and three meals a day, raising me all on her own."
nodes.hlv3_039: Ryuji Sakaguchi stands quietly beside her without interrupting.
nodes.hlv3_040: "Watching how hard she worked back then, I always thought that once I graduated from nursing school and became a full-fledged nurse, it would be my turn to take good care of her. Yet not long after I finally put on my nurse's uniform, my mother collapsed from a chronic condition and needed long-term inpatient care and observation."
nodes.hlv3_041: The light turns green, and the two cross the street to the bus stop ahead.
nodes.hlv3_043: "Do you often come over like this after work to keep her company?"
nodes.hlv3_044: "Yes. Whenever my shift schedule allows and it doesn't interfere with my work at Hoshimi, I come by two or three times a week to check on her, bring fresh daily necessities, or bring a picture book she likes, like today."
nodes.hlv3_045: She looks down at the thermos in her hand, a faintly self-deprecating yet tender smile touching her lips:
nodes.hlv3_046: "Even though I'm a nurse myself and completely used to caring for patients at the hospital every day, sometimes after a full day of surgeries, when I'm hurrying over here right after work, I still can't help worrying whether her spirits are good today... and every once in a while, it does feel a little tiring."
nodes.hlv3_047: At that, she quickly lifts her head again, her eyes clear and composed:
nodes.hlv3_048: "Still, the doctors and nurses over there take wonderful care of her, and her condition has been very stable. At Hoshimi Hospital, aside from Manami—who has known me for a long time—I haven't mentioned this to any of our other colleagues."
nodes.hlv3_049: Ryuji Sakaguchi looks at her and smiles lightly:
nodes.hlv3_050: "Waiting until we walked all the way here to tell me—does that mean I passed Nurse Sugimura's inspection?"
nodes.hlv3_051: Hiroko Sugimura blinks, the slight stiffness from speaking of family matters melting away as she lets out a soft laugh:
nodes.hlv3_052: "Hehe, that's because Dr. Sakaguchi is always so dependable. As we were walking together, I just felt it would be alright to tell you."
nodes.hlv3_053: Ryuji Sakaguchi speaks gently and earnestly:
nodes.hlv3_054: "Balancing both sides on your own for this long really hasn't been easy."
nodes.hlv3_055: Hiroko Sugimura gently shakes her head, her gaze soft yet steady:
nodes.hlv3_056: "Because she's my mother. Seeing her safe and sound actually makes me feel more grounded at work."
nodes.hlv3_057: The bus pulls smoothly into the stop. Without prying into her mother's specific diagnosis or offering as a physician to review her chart or step into her care, Ryuji Sakaguchi simply boards the bus to the neighboring hospital beside her.
nodes.hlv3_058: At ten past six in the evening, the inpatient lobby of the municipal general hospital glows with warm light, filled mostly with visiting family members carrying meal boxes and fruit baskets.
nodes.hlv3_059: Reaching the public waiting area in front of the elevators, Ryuji Sakaguchi stops and gestures toward a bench:
nodes.hlv3_060: "I'll wait for you right here in the lounge area. Take your time catching up with your mother—no need to rush down."
nodes.hlv3_061: Hiroko Sugimura pauses, looking at him apologetically:
nodes.hlv3_062: "Leaving you sitting down here waiting for me, Doctor... isn't that too impolite?"
nodes.hlv3_064: "I didn't come here today as a doctor on rounds. That's time for you and your mother—reading a magazine out here suits me just fine. Go on."
nodes.hlv3_065: Hearing those words, a unmistakable warmth crosses Hiroko's eyes. Without standing on ceremony any further, she gives a gentle nod:
nodes.hlv3_066: "...Yes. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi. I'll just head up for a visit and be right back down."
nodes.hlv3_067: After sitting on the bench in the public waiting area for about half an hour, the elevator doors chime and slide open once more.
nodes.hlv3_068: Hiroko Sugimura steps out carrying the now half-empty paper bag. Compared to the slightly preoccupied look she wore when arriving, her brow is noticeably lighter, and even her footsteps carry a brisk ease.
nodes.hlv3_069: Ryuji Sakaguchi stands up from the bench:
nodes.hlv3_070: "Back down already? How is your mother feeling today?"
nodes.hlv3_071: Walking up to him, Hiroko Sugimura cannot help curving her eyes in a bright smile:
nodes.hlv3_072: "She's in great spirits! The moment she got that gardening book, she couldn't stop flipping through it—she even pointed at the hydrangeas inside and said she wants to plant two pots on the balcony once she's discharged."
nodes.hlv3_073: She pauses and lets out a fond, helpless sigh, her eyes brimming with unmistakable warmth:
nodes.hlv3_074: "And then after barely two sentences, she started patting the back of my hand and fretting again, asking whether I'd eaten dinner yet or if I'd just grabbed a piece of bread to save time... Even though I'm a full-fledged operating room nurse now, in her eyes it's like I'll always be a little girl who needs reminding to eat on time."
nodes.hlv3_076: "In a mother's eyes, a daughter is still a child no matter how old she gets. Though you really haven't had dinner yet tonight, have you?"
nodes.hlv3_077: Hiroko Sugimura touches her cheek a little sheepishly:
nodes.hlv3_078: "Mom shared half of the tangerine she was saving with me up in the ward, so I'm not too hungry right now. Let's step outside for some fresh air first, Doctor."
nodes.hlv3_079: By the time they step out of the inpatient building, night has fully fallen. Row after row of softly lit ward windows glow quietly against the dark sky in the distance.
nodes.hlv3_080: Walking along the path outside the hospital for a few minutes, they stop beside a wooden bench in a small pocket park and sit down side by side.
nodes.hlv3_081: After a quiet moment, Hiroko Sugimura folds the empty paper bag neatly on her lap, turns to look back at the brightly lit inpatient building behind them, and speaks softly:
nodes.hlv3_082: "Dr. Sakaguchi, you must have been wondering earlier—since having a parent in the hospital is such a normal thing, why haven't I ever mentioned it to anyone despite working at Hoshimi Hospital for so long?"
nodes.hlv3_083: Ryuji Sakaguchi looks at her profile:
nodes.hlv3_084: "Everyone has their own reasons for not bringing family matters into the workplace."
nodes.hlv3_085: Hiroko Sugimura nods gently, her gaze earnest and clear:
nodes.hlv3_086: "Everyone at Hoshimi Hospital is wonderful—the director, the doctors, and all the nurses in the department are so considerate. But precisely because everyone is so kind... I know very well that once people find out I have a hospitalized mother at home with no one else around, every time a heavy major operation is scheduled or someone is needed to cover a night shift, everyone will hesitate and think, 'Nurse Sugimura has a sick family member to care for, so let's not assign it to her.'"
nodes.hlv3_087: Her fingers tighten on her lap, her voice quiet yet unmistakably firm:
nodes.hlv3_088: "I truly love Hoshimi Hospital's operating room, and I cherish my place standing beside the operating table working with the team. When the doctors entrust an important operation to me, I want it to be because they trust 'Hiroko Sugimura's professional skill'—not because the first thing they see is someone with difficulties at home who needs special consideration."
nodes.hlv3_089: She turns her face toward Ryuji Sakaguchi, the glow of the streetlamp reflected in her eyes:
nodes.hlv3_090: "If the day ever comes when my mother genuinely needs me to take leave or adjust my shifts, I'll apply to the hospital openly through the proper channels. Until then, I don't want everyone tiptoeing around me and arranging a way out before I've even said a word."
nodes.hlv3_091: Having said all that in one breath, Hiroko suddenly realizes how much she has poured out; the tips of her fair ears flush slightly as she lowers her head in mild embarrassment:
nodes.hlv3_092: "...I'm sorry, Dr. Sakaguchi. Did I suddenly talk way too much about things unrelated to work?"
nodes.hlv3_093: Looking at her faintly reddened ears, Ryuji Sakaguchi speaks with gentle sincerity:
nodes.hlv3_094: "There's nothing to apologize for. Thank you for being willing to tell me all this, Hiroko."
nodes.hlv3_095: Hiroko Sugimura raises her eyes to look at him.
nodes.hlv3_096: "I understand how you feel completely. Rest assured, when we return to Hoshimi's operating room tomorrow, you're still Nurse Sugimura, my most trusted partner. Whether you ever tell anyone else about tonight—and when—is entirely up to you. Even if you need a schedule adjustment someday, we'll handle it through standard hospital procedures; I won't take it upon myself to give you special treatment."
nodes.hlv3_097: Hearing his answer, the slight tension in Hiroko's shoulders eases away.
nodes.hlv3_098: She lets out a long, soft breath, her eyes curving into crescents again as she reminds him in a half-playful, half-serious tone:
nodes.hlv3_099: "Hearing you say that puts my mind completely at ease. Though Doctor, if you start being extra polite to me in the operating room tomorrow because of this, you'll really put me in a bind."
nodes.hlv3_101: "Don't worry—when it's time to call for instruments tomorrow, I won't slow down by half a beat just because you treated me to the evening breeze tonight."
nodes.hlv3_102: Hiroko Sugimura lets out a soft giggle:
nodes.hlv3_104: Rising from the bench, the two chat about light, everyday things along the brightly lit street until they reach the corner in front of the train station.
nodes.hlv3_105: The sound of an evening train pulling in drifts faintly down from the elevated platform above.
nodes.hlv3_106: Hiroko Sugimura stops before the station entrance and turns to face Ryuji Sakaguchi, her hands folded over the small bag in front of her.
nodes.hlv3_107: "Thank you so much for walking all the way over here with me tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.hlv3_108: "I didn't help with a single thing today—I just tagged along for a walk."
nodes.hlv3_109: Hiroko Sugimura gently shakes her head, her gaze warm and heartfelt as she looks at him:
nodes.hlv3_110: "No, that alone was more than enough. Truthfully, when I called out to you after work today, it wasn't because I wanted you to do anything for me... I just looked at your face and suddenly felt that if it was Dr. Sakaguchi, it would be okay to tell you."
nodes.hlv3_111: The night breeze brushes softly across her bangs; she pauses for a heartbeat, her voice softening:
nodes.hlv3_112: "Something I've been carrying quietly on my own all this time—having someone willing to just listen to me talk it through like tonight really makes my heart feel so much lighter."
nodes.hlv3_113: Across the soft halo of the streetlamps, the two share a quiet look as the evening breeze drifts past the peaceful corner.
nodes.hlv3_115: "Whenever you need company for a walk again, just call me anytime. Get some rest tonight—see you in the operating room tomorrow."
nodes.hlv3_116: A bright, cheerful smile blossoms across Hiroko Sugimura's face as she nods firmly:
nodes.hlv3_117: "Yes! Please be careful on your way home too, Doctor. See you tomorrow, Dr. Sakaguchi!"
nodes.hlv3_118: Giving Ryuji a wave, she turns and walks with a light step up the stairs toward the platform.

hiroko_summer_fireworks.title: Summer Night Fireworks
hiroko_summer_fireworks.teaser: On a warm summer evening without night duty, Hiroko invites you to the annual riverside fireworks festival in a morning-glory yukata.

choices.finish_hiroko_summer_fireworks_lv3: Watch Hiroko walk up the station steps in her yukata
choices.finish_hiroko_summer_fireworks_lv4: Walk hand in hand with Hiroko into the warm lights of the station
choices.choice_hsf_lv3_029_1: "Then I'll leave the rest of our stall tour entirely in Guide Sugimura's hands."
choices.choice_hsf_lv3_029_2: "Leading the way is fine, but since you're wearing geta today, there's no rush—take your time."
choices.choice_hsf_lv4_029_1: "Then I'll leave the rest of our stall tour entirely in Guide Sugimura's hands."
choices.choice_hsf_lv4_029_2: "Leading the way is fine, but since you're wearing geta today, there's no rush—take your time."

nodes.hsf_lv3_001: The midsummer evening air carries a warm river breeze; rows of red-and-white lanterns already hang across the festival grounds in the distance, accompanied by the lively sound of taiko drums and flutes.
nodes.hsf_lv3_002: Several days ago, Hiroko Sugimura carefully picked out an evening off when neither of them had night duty and took the initiative to invite Ryuji Sakaguchi to the annual riverside summer fireworks festival.
nodes.hsf_lv3_003: Arriving at the agreed-upon street-corner clock tower a few minutes early, Ryuji Sakaguchi is looking around when the crisp clatter of wooden geta against flagstones suddenly sounds behind him.
nodes.hsf_lv3_004: "Dr. Sakaguchi, have I kept you waiting long?"
nodes.hsf_lv3_005: Ryuji Sakaguchi turns around, and his gaze freezes on the spot.
nodes.hsf_lv3_006: Standing in the afterglow of sunset, Hiroko Sugimura is wearing neither her crisp white nurse's uniform nor her usual knit casual clothes. Instead, she is dressed in a soft navy summer yukata patterned with pale pink morning glories, a pale-yellow heko obi accentuating her slender waist; her hair, normally worn smoothly down, is swept up into a neat yet graceful updo that reveals the fair, slender line of her nape and collarbone.
nodes.hsf_lv3_007: Meeting Ryuji's momentarily stunned gaze, Hiroko's fingers tighten slightly around her woven bamboo pouch, a trace of quiet anticipation in her eyes.
nodes.hsf_lv3_008: After barely two seconds, however, she gracefully lifts the sleeve of her yukata, spins half a turn in front of him, and tilts her head with a teasing smile:
nodes.hsf_lv3_009: "Why are you staring at me without saying a word... Don't tell me you thought I only ever wear a nurse's uniform even after work, Dr. Sakaguchi?"
nodes.hsf_lv3_010: Coming back to his senses, Ryuji Sakaguchi smiles candidly:
nodes.hsf_lv3_011: "Seeing you in a yukata with your hair pinned up is such a striking contrast from how you usually look at the hospital that I got completely transfixed for a moment. You look beautiful—it really suits you."
nodes.hsf_lv3_012: At such a straightforward compliment, a faint blush rises to Hiroko's cheeks, though she lifts her chin with feigned composure and gives a playful wink:
nodes.hsf_lv3_013: "Hehe, since Dr. Sakaguchi praised me so sincerely, starting my preparations two hours early today was well worth it. Come on—if we wait any longer, the stalls inside will have huge lines!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_014: As the sky deepens into a rich ultramarine, hundreds of paper lanterns along both sides of the approach light up all at once, illuminating the riverside night market as bright as day.
nodes.hsf_lv3_015: Weaving through the bustling crowd in summer yukata, Hiroko looks over the festival stalls lining the path with lively enthusiasm.
nodes.hsf_lv3_016: "Look over there! Ramune soda chilled in wooden tubs, plus freshly grilled salted ayu and shaved ice—if you don't take a sip of ice-cold ramune before watching summer fireworks, it feels like half the ritual is missing!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_017: Ryuji Sakaguchi follows her lead with a smile. The stall owner hands over two glass bottles of ramune beaded with condensation, cheerfully tossing in a bamboo festival fan printed with a fireworks motif.
nodes.hsf_lv3_018: Taking the bottles, Ryuji presses the glass marble down into the neck of Hiroko's bottle for her.
nodes.hsf_lv3_019: With a crisp pop, cool bubbles fizz up inside. Hiroko happily takes the bamboo fan and soda bottle, sips a mouthful, and narrows her eyes in satisfaction:
nodes.hsf_lv3_020: "Mmm—so refreshing! When you have time off in the summer, do you usually come visit lively night markets like this?"
nodes.hsf_lv3_021: Ryuji Sakaguchi takes a sip of his ramune:
nodes.hsf_lv3_022: "Mostly I've been busy with work or reading over papers, and even when I passed by occasionally, I never felt much like squeezing into a crowd on my own. I didn't expect you to love the lively atmosphere of a festival this much, though."
nodes.hsf_lv3_023: Hiroko Sugimura swirls the blue glass bottle in her hand, laughing as if it were the most natural thing in the world:
nodes.hsf_lv3_024: "Work is always so busy every day, so being able to stroll through a summer festival in the night breeze and snack along with everyone makes my whole body feel lighter."
nodes.hsf_lv3_025: She lightly taps the back of Ryuji's hand with her new bamboo fan, adding teasingly:
nodes.hsf_lv3_026: "You, on the other hand, still look so serious even while holding a bottle of ramune in front of a takoyaki stall—relax a little more!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_029: "Super obvious! Still, don't worry—with me leading the way tonight, I guarantee you'll experience a proper summer night festival."
nodes.hsf_lv3_030: Raising the bottle of ramune in his hand, Ryuji Sakaguchi plays along with her joke:
nodes.hsf_lv3_031: "Then I'll leave the rest of our stall tour entirely in Guide Sugimura's hands."
nodes.hsf_lv3_032: Hiroko Sugimura's eyes light up; tapping her chin lightly with the handle of her bamboo fan, she nods with mock solemnity:
nodes.hsf_lv3_033: "Hehe, that's the spirit! Then let's start with that takoyaki stall up ahead with the longest line—and on our way back after the fireworks, we have to try the candied apples in crisp sugar glaze too!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_034: Glancing down at the wooden geta on her feet, Ryuji Sakaguchi slows his pace by half a step and reminds her gently:
nodes.hsf_lv3_035: "Leading the way is fine, but since you're wearing geta today, there's no rush—take your time."
nodes.hsf_lv3_036: Hiroko Sugimura blinks, looking down at her wooden geta with their pale-pink straps as a soft warmth touches her cheeks. Slowing her pace a little to walk closer beside Ryuji, she laughs softly:
nodes.hsf_lv3_037: "...Here I was trying to lead you all around the festival, and somehow you're the one looking out for me again. Alright, let's take our time walking over, then."
nodes.hsf_lv3_038: Trading light banter, the two continue down the lantern-lit approach.
nodes.hsf_lv3_039: As seven-thirty approaches, an announcement over the speakers signals that the fireworks display is about to begin. All at once, the crowds scattered across the stalls surge toward the stone steps of the riverbank viewing area.
nodes.hsf_lv3_040: In the blink of an eye, the surrounding crowd grows dense, passersby brushing past and narrowing the space between them.
nodes.hsf_lv3_041: In her wooden geta, Hiroko Sugimura sways slightly amid the stream of people, looking up toward the crowded embankment slope ahead.
nodes.hsf_lv3_042: As the crowd ahead thickens, Hiroko cannot walk very quickly in her geta.
nodes.hsf_lv3_043: Seeing that a group of oncoming festivalgoers is about to separate them, Hiroko Sugimura hesitates for half a second before reaching out and lightly catching the cuff of Ryuji Sakaguchi's shirt with her fingertips.
nodes.hsf_lv3_044: Feeling the gentle tug at his sleeve, Ryuji Sakaguchi immediately slows down, turning to step half a pace closer to shield her from the pressing crowd.
nodes.hsf_lv3_045: Looking down at her fingers pinching his cuff, her fair ears flushing faintly in the lantern light, Hiroko Sugimura explains in a small, slightly self-conscious voice:
nodes.hsf_lv3_046: "U-um... there are so many people heading up the embankment steps, and I can't walk fast in geta today. If we get separated in the crowd, we won't even be able to hear our phones ring once the fireworks start, and that would be a real hassle..."
nodes.hsf_lv3_047: Looking down at her faintly flushed cheek, Ryuji Sakaguchi does not call out her excuse.
nodes.hsf_lv3_048: After a brief pause, he lowers his arm slightly and very naturally closes his hand around hers where it rests at his cuff.
nodes.hsf_lv3_049: His warm fingers gently fold over her cool fingertips. Hiroko Sugimura's shoulders give a tiny tremor as she raises her eyes to him, her breath skipping half a beat amid the surrounding clamor.
nodes.hsf_lv3_050: Yet she does not pull her fingers back; after a fleeting moment of shyness, she gently squeezes his hand back and curves her eyes with a quiet, playful remark:
nodes.hsf_lv3_051: "...Since Dr. Sakaguchi took my hand first, if I still get lost later, it'll be entirely the primary surgeon's responsibility."
nodes.hsf_lv3_052: Ryuji Sakaguchi smiles, holding her hand securely:
nodes.hsf_lv3_054: Making their way up the lively stone steps, the two finally find an open spot with a clear view near the top of the grassy embankment slope.
nodes.hsf_lv3_055: Below them lies the wide, shimmering surface of the river; across the water, the floodlights at the launch site have gone dark, and the surrounding crowd falls into a hushed anticipation.
nodes.hsf_lv3_058: The first great golden shell trails a long whistle straight up into the night sky and bursts open directly overhead.
nodes.hsf_lv3_059: A dazzling shower of gold and crimson instantly lights up the ink-blue summer sky, followed in quick succession by second and third chrysanthemum and weeping-willow shells, their layered brilliance flickering across the river and the upturned faces of the crowd.
nodes.hsf_lv3_060: Waves of cheers and admiration rise all around them.
nodes.hsf_lv3_061: Ryuji Sakaguchi turns his head to look at Hiroko Sugimura beside him.
nodes.hsf_lv3_062: The blossoms of fire filling the sky reflect in Hiroko's clear eyes, tinting her fair profile a warm orange-gold. The river breeze stirs a lock of hair at her temple, and the wide sleeve of her yukata sways gently in the night wind, brushing against Ryuji's arm.
nodes.hsf_lv3_063: Tilting her head back slightly, she gazes up at the radiant night sky in pure, quiet absorption.
nodes.hsf_lv3_064: In the pause as a giant brocade crown shell slowly dissolves into falling stardust, Hiroko lets out a soft breath, her voice remarkably gentle and unadorned amid the distant rumble and river wind:
nodes.hsf_lv3_065: "...I'm really glad we could come this year."
nodes.hsf_lv3_066: Watching her profile illuminated by the fireworks, Ryuji Sakaguchi replies softly:
nodes.hsf_lv3_067: "Yeah. Being able to stand here and watch them with you like this is really nice."
nodes.hsf_lv3_068: Hearing Ryuji's reply, Hiroko turns her head slightly, her eyes meeting his for a heartbeat in the flickering light of the fireworks.
nodes.hsf_lv3_069: Both of them are clearly aware of how much closer they are standing than usual. Without an extra word, Hiroko simply gives the fingers still intertwined with his a gentle squeeze, curves her lips in a slightly shy smile, and looks back up at the night sky.
nodes.hsf_lv3_070: When the final grand finale barrage fades from the night sky, long applause echoes along the riverbank, and the spectators begin chatting and laughing as they slowly file back toward the station.
nodes.hsf_lv3_071: Walking along the return path atop the embankment, Hiroko—who had been so quietly absorbed beneath the fireworks—quickly regains her usual bright, spirited energy.
nodes.hsf_lv3_072: Fanning herself lightly with the bamboo fan in her hand, she turns toward Ryuji with a touch of pride:
nodes.hsf_lv3_073: "How was it, Dr. Sakaguchi? That blue-violet hydrangea firework third from the end was super pretty, wasn't it? I told you that embankment slope I picked had the best view—we could even see the reflections on the water across the river crystal clear!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_075: "You really picked the perfect spot—nothing less from Guide Sugimura after doing all her homework."
nodes.hsf_lv3_076: Hiroko Sugimura giggles, tilting her head to size him up teasingly:
nodes.hsf_lv3_077: "Though when that very first firework went off earlier, you were staring at the night sky so intently that you didn't even hear me call your name once."
nodes.hsf_lv3_078: Ryuji Sakaguchi gives a helpless smile:
nodes.hsf_lv3_079: "I was busy watching the fireworks... and watching the person standing next to me."
nodes.hsf_lv3_080: Hiroko Sugimura's cheeks warm slightly; she raises the bamboo fan to lightly cover the lower half of her face, though the corners of her eyes curve like crescent moons:
nodes.hsf_lv3_081: "...You really know how to say things like that out of nowhere tonight, Doctor. Alright, the station entrance is right ahead—thank you for coming to see the fireworks with me today, Doctor. I had a wonderful time. Please be careful on your way home, and see you at the hospital!"
nodes.hsf_lv3_082: Giving Ryuji a gentle wave, she lifts the hem of her yukata slightly and walks up the station steps with the light clatter of her geta.
nodes.hsf_lv4_001: The midsummer evening air carries a warm river breeze; rows of red-and-white lanterns already hang across the festival grounds in the distance, accompanied by the lively sound of taiko drums and flutes.
nodes.hsf_lv4_002: Several days ago, Hiroko Sugimura carefully picked out an evening off when neither of them had night duty and took the initiative to invite Ryuji Sakaguchi to the annual riverside summer fireworks festival.
nodes.hsf_lv4_003: Arriving at the agreed-upon street-corner clock tower a few minutes early, Ryuji Sakaguchi is looking around when the crisp clatter of wooden geta against flagstones suddenly sounds behind him.
nodes.hsf_lv4_004: "Ryuji, have I kept you waiting long?"
nodes.hsf_lv4_005: Ryuji Sakaguchi turns around, and his gaze freezes on the spot.
nodes.hsf_lv4_006: Standing in the afterglow of sunset, Hiroko Sugimura is wearing neither her crisp white nurse's uniform nor her usual knit casual clothes. Instead, she is dressed in a soft navy summer yukata patterned with pale pink morning glories, a pale-yellow heko obi accentuating her slender waist; her hair, normally worn smoothly down, is swept up into a neat yet graceful updo that reveals the fair, slender line of her nape and collarbone.
nodes.hsf_lv4_007: Meeting Ryuji's momentarily stunned gaze, Hiroko's fingers tighten slightly around her woven bamboo pouch, a trace of quiet anticipation in her eyes.
nodes.hsf_lv4_008: After barely two seconds, however, she gracefully lifts the sleeve of her yukata, spins half a turn in front of him, and tilts her head with a teasing smile:
nodes.hsf_lv4_009: "Why are you staring at me without saying a word... Don't tell me you thought I only ever wear a nurse's uniform even after work, Dr. Sakaguchi?"
nodes.hsf_lv4_010: Coming back to his senses, Ryuji Sakaguchi smiles candidly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_011: "Seeing you in a yukata with your hair pinned up is such a striking contrast from how you usually look at the hospital that I got completely transfixed for a moment. You look beautiful—it really suits you."
nodes.hsf_lv4_012: At such a straightforward compliment, Hiroko's eyes curve into a warm smile; she naturally steps half a pace closer, tilting her face up and lowering her voice teasingly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_013: "Hehe, since my boyfriend says he was completely transfixed, starting my preparations two hours early today wasn't wasted effort at all. Let's go, Ryuji—I've been looking forward to tonight's fireworks festival for so long!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_014: As the sky deepens into a rich ultramarine, hundreds of paper lanterns along both sides of the approach light up all at once, illuminating the riverside night market as bright as day.
nodes.hsf_lv4_015: Weaving through the bustling crowd in summer yukata, Hiroko looks over the festival stalls lining the path with lively enthusiasm.
nodes.hsf_lv4_016: "Look over there! Ramune soda chilled in wooden tubs, plus freshly grilled salted ayu and shaved ice—if you don't take a sip of ice-cold ramune before watching summer fireworks, it feels like half the ritual is missing!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_017: Ryuji Sakaguchi follows her lead with a smile. The stall owner hands over two glass bottles of ramune beaded with condensation, cheerfully tossing in a bamboo festival fan printed with a fireworks motif.
nodes.hsf_lv4_018: Taking the bottles, Ryuji presses the glass marble down into the neck of Hiroko's bottle for her.
nodes.hsf_lv4_019: With a crisp pop, cool bubbles fizz up inside. Hiroko happily takes the bamboo fan and soda bottle, sips a mouthful, and narrows her eyes in satisfaction:
nodes.hsf_lv4_020: "Mmm—so refreshing! When you have time off in the summer, do you usually come visit lively night markets like this?"
nodes.hsf_lv4_021: Ryuji Sakaguchi takes a sip of his ramune:
nodes.hsf_lv4_022: "Mostly I've been busy with work or reading over papers, and even when I passed by occasionally, I never felt much like squeezing into a crowd on my own. I didn't expect you to love the lively atmosphere of a festival this much, though."
nodes.hsf_lv4_023: Hiroko Sugimura swirls the blue glass bottle in her hand, laughing as if it were the most natural thing in the world:
nodes.hsf_lv4_024: "Work is always so busy every day, so being able to stroll through a summer festival in the night breeze and snack along with everyone makes my whole body feel lighter."
nodes.hsf_lv4_025: She lightly taps the back of Ryuji's hand with her new bamboo fan, adding teasingly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_026: "You, on the other hand, still look so serious even while holding a bottle of ramune in front of a takoyaki stall—relax a little more!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_029: "Super obvious! Still, don't worry—with me leading the way tonight, I guarantee you'll experience a proper summer night festival."
nodes.hsf_lv4_030: Raising the bottle of ramune in his hand, Ryuji Sakaguchi plays along with her joke:
nodes.hsf_lv4_031: "Then I'll leave the rest of our stall tour entirely in Guide Sugimura's hands."
nodes.hsf_lv4_032: Hiroko Sugimura's eyes light up; tapping her chin lightly with the handle of her bamboo fan, she nods with mock solemnity:
nodes.hsf_lv4_033: "Hehe, that's the spirit! Then let's start with that takoyaki stall up ahead with the longest line—and on our way back after the fireworks, we have to try the candied apples in crisp sugar glaze too!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_034: Glancing down at the wooden geta on her feet, Ryuji Sakaguchi slows his pace by half a step and reminds her gently:
nodes.hsf_lv4_035: "Leading the way is fine, but since you're wearing geta today, there's no rush—take your time."
nodes.hsf_lv4_036: Hiroko Sugimura blinks, looking down at her wooden geta with their pale-pink straps as a soft warmth touches her cheeks. Slowing her pace a little to walk closer beside Ryuji, she laughs softly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_037: "...Here I was trying to lead you all around the festival, and somehow you're the one looking out for me again. Alright, let's take our time walking over, then."
nodes.hsf_lv4_038: Trading light banter, the two continue down the lantern-lit approach.
nodes.hsf_lv4_039: As seven-thirty approaches, an announcement over the speakers signals that the fireworks display is about to begin. All at once, the crowds scattered across the stalls surge toward the stone steps of the riverbank viewing area.
nodes.hsf_lv4_040: In the blink of an eye, the surrounding crowd grows dense, passersby brushing past and narrowing the space between them.
nodes.hsf_lv4_041: In her wooden geta, Hiroko Sugimura sways slightly amid the stream of people, looking up toward the crowded embankment slope ahead.
nodes.hsf_lv4_042: As the crowd ahead thickens, Hiroko slows her pace in her wooden geta.
nodes.hsf_lv4_043: Before Ryuji Sakaguchi even reaches out to steady her, Hiroko Sugimura naturally slips her hand into his palm, twining her fingers snugly with his.
nodes.hsf_lv4_044: Steadying her steps in the geta against his arm, she leans close to his side, looks up into the warm glow of the lanterns, and gives a playful wink:
nodes.hsf_lv4_045: "Hehe, with a crowd this big, if I don't hold onto my boyfriend tightly, what would I do if we got squeezed apart?"
nodes.hsf_lv4_046: Closing his hand firmly around her soft fingers, Ryuji Sakaguchi chuckles:
nodes.hsf_lv4_047: "Seeing how enthusiastically you were leading the way just now, I thought you were too busy to hold hands."
nodes.hsf_lv4_048: Hiroko Sugimura leans lightly against his arm, giving him a playfully reproachful glance:
nodes.hsf_lv4_049: "You're the one who wasn't taking the initiative in the crowd, Ryuji, and now you're turning it around on me. I'm wearing geta today—if you don't hold onto me steadily, I'll make you carry me on your back when my feet get tired later."
nodes.hsf_lv4_050: Ryuji Sakaguchi laughs, drawing her a little closer to his side:
nodes.hsf_lv4_051: "Then I'd better hold on tight. The embankment slope is right ahead—take the steps slowly."
nodes.hsf_lv4_052: With a sweet curve of her lips, Hiroko Sugimura leans comfortably beside him as the two walk through the bustling crowd with fingers intertwined.
nodes.hsf_lv4_053: Making their way up the lively stone steps, the two finally find an open spot with a clear view near the top of the grassy embankment slope.
nodes.hsf_lv4_054: Below them lies the wide, shimmering surface of the river; across the water, the floodlights at the launch site have gone dark, and the surrounding crowd falls into a hushed anticipation.
nodes.hsf_lv4_057: The first great golden shell trails a long whistle straight up into the night sky and bursts open directly overhead.
nodes.hsf_lv4_058: A dazzling shower of gold and crimson instantly lights up the ink-blue summer sky, followed in quick succession by second and third chrysanthemum and weeping-willow shells, their layered brilliance flickering across the river and the upturned faces of the crowd.
nodes.hsf_lv4_059: Waves of cheers and admiration rise all around them.
nodes.hsf_lv4_060: Ryuji Sakaguchi turns his head to look at Hiroko Sugimura beside him.
nodes.hsf_lv4_061: The blossoms of fire filling the sky reflect in Hiroko's clear eyes, tinting her fair profile a warm orange-gold. The river breeze stirs a lock of hair at her temple, and the wide sleeve of her yukata sways gently in the night wind, brushing against Ryuji's arm.
nodes.hsf_lv4_062: Tilting her head back slightly, she gazes up at the radiant night sky in pure, quiet absorption.
nodes.hsf_lv4_063: In the pause as a giant brocade crown shell slowly dissolves into falling stardust, Hiroko lets out a soft breath, her voice remarkably gentle and unadorned amid the distant rumble and river wind:
nodes.hsf_lv4_064: "...I'm really glad we could come this year."
nodes.hsf_lv4_065: Watching her profile illuminated by the fireworks, Ryuji Sakaguchi replies softly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_066: "Yeah. Being able to stand here and watch them with you like this is really nice."
nodes.hsf_lv4_067: Hearing Ryuji's reply, Hiroko's eyes curve softly, and she rests her cheek unhesitatingly against his shoulder.
nodes.hsf_lv4_068: With her soft updo brushing his shoulder, she watches another multicolored chrysanthemum shell rise into the night sky and murmurs softly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_069: "Let's come watch them together again whenever we get the chance, Ryuji."
nodes.hsf_lv4_070: Ryuji Sakaguchi gives her hand a gentle squeeze and answers warmly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_071: "Yeah. Anytime you want to see them, we'll come together again."
nodes.hsf_lv4_072: When the final grand finale barrage fades from the night sky, long applause echoes along the riverbank, and the spectators begin chatting and laughing as they slowly file back toward the station.
nodes.hsf_lv4_073: Walking along the return path atop the embankment, Hiroko—who had been so quietly absorbed beneath the fireworks—quickly regains her usual bright, spirited energy.
nodes.hsf_lv4_074: Fanning herself lightly with the bamboo fan in her hand, she turns toward Ryuji with a touch of pride:
nodes.hsf_lv4_075: "How was it, Ryuji? That blue-violet hydrangea firework third from the end was super pretty, wasn't it? I told you that embankment slope I picked had the best view—we could even see the reflections on the water across the river crystal clear!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_077: "You really picked the perfect spot—nothing less from Guide Sugimura after doing all her homework."
nodes.hsf_lv4_078: Hiroko Sugimura giggles, tilting her head to size him up teasingly:
nodes.hsf_lv4_079: "Though when that very first firework went off earlier, you were staring at the night sky so intently that you didn't even hear me call your name once."
nodes.hsf_lv4_080: Ryuji Sakaguchi gives a helpless smile:
nodes.hsf_lv4_081: "I was busy watching the fireworks... and watching the person standing next to me."
nodes.hsf_lv4_082: The tips of Hiroko Sugimura's ears flush faintly, yet she openly swings their still-joined hands and teases him using her workplace form of address:
nodes.hsf_lv4_083: "Who knew our 'Dr. Sakaguchi' could talk so smoothly in private—you get full marks for tonight. Come on, Ryuji, let's take the train back together before the station entrance gets completely packed!"
nodes.hsf_lv4_084: In the warm summer night breeze, the two walk hand in hand, chatting and laughing as they merge into the warm lights of the station.
